posts.author: Parnash
posts.body:
Hey everyone - recently my RPG Maker MV keeps crashing while I'm trying to work on it - sometimes it works fine, other times it explodes violently (not really, but it makes me lose a lot of stuff). It tends to flash white a lot as well, and I haven't seen the splash screen come up (the one that says stuff like 'here's DLC and whatnot', I honestly forgot what it says because I never used it before).
Then, last time it crashed, I got this for the first time:
Anybody have any suggestions?

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
It may or may not be related, but
@SGHarlekin
recently reported issues with RMMV with memory usage. Although inconclusive, it seems the most likely culprit was a Win11 update. (other users have also reported this problem, which is why I believe it's an operating system problem and not something related to the app)
That being said a Visual C++ crash error I do not believe was reported with Harlekin's crash. You may consider reinstalling your Microsoft Visual C++ run time.
That being said, I'm not sure which version is necessary. It might be easier to do a clean installation of RM.

posts.author: Parnash
posts.body:
I hope it's not a Windows thing. I did see the memory thing before this, and did the update to fix that - it sort of worked and it made the game crash LESS, but it's still crashing. I also did a reinstall of RPG Maker before doing the memory fix, and that didn't fix it either.
I'll see about Microsoft Visual C++, though I'm not sure exactly how to do that.
